tickets.title: RedPower Lamp: block definitions, metadata colors, creative tabs, and crafting recipes
tickets.description: Register block content and crafting recipes for 16-color standard and inverted RedPower lamps. Configure block properties (hardness 0.5, sounds glass, light level 15 for lit states), loot tables (breaking active/inactive standard lamps drops unlit lamp; breaking active/inactive inverted lamps drops lit inverted lamp item), creative tab registrations, and crafting recipes (6x Glass + 1x Lumar + 1x Redstone Dust for standard lamp; 6x Glass + 1x Lumar + 1x Redstone Torch for inverted lamp across all 16 lumar dye colors). Write contract files for inverted lamp states. Done: contract-check clean for inverted_lamp and lamp_inverted_lit; recipes craft correct colored lamp items.

tickets.title: RedPower Lamp: pass 0 base block and inventory rendering
tickets.description: Implement Pass 0 block rendering and item inventory rendering matching RenderLamp.java and BlockLamp.java. Pass 0 renders full 1x1x1 cube with sprite index 16+md for unlit states (tint (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), directional localLights [0.5, 1.0, 0.8, 0.8, 0.6, 0.6], renderGlobFaces) and 32+md for lit states (tint (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), emissive localLights [1.0; 6], renderFlat). Inventory renders bounds [-0.5, -0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5] with directional lights and sprite 16+md (unlit) or 32+md (lit). Done: contract-check model verification clean for pass 0 and inventory render tests passing.

tickets.title: RedPower Lamp: pass 1 colored halo bloom box rendering
tickets.description: Implement Pass 1 colored halo bloom rendering for lit lamps matching RenderLamp.java. When lit, render pass 1 draws an expanded bounding box [-0.05, -0.05, -0.05, 1.05, 1.05, 1.05] with additive blending (GL 770, 1 / GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE), depth mask disabled, texture disabled, tint from lightColors[md] array of 16 RGB values, and alpha 0.5 (renderAlpha(63, 0.5F)). Resets depth mask and blend mode. Done: halo bloom geometry, color unpacking and render tests passing.

tickets.title: RedPower Lamp: redstone power state toggle and neighbor update handling
tickets.description: Implement power state checking and neighbor block update handling for standard and inverted lamps in mods/redpower_2/src/lighting/logic.rs matching BlockLamp.java. Check RedPowerLib.isPowered (handling vanilla redstone, weak power, strong power, and bundled cables). Standard lamp toggles off -> lit on power and lit -> off on signal loss; inverted lamp toggles lit -> off on power and off -> lit on signal loss. Preserve metadata across state swaps. Done: lamp state transition logic unit tests passing.

tickets.title: RedPower Lamp: level 1 and level 4 verification scenario tests
tickets.description: Write contract integration scenarios for all 16 lamp colors across standard and inverted variants. Verify placement, hitbox, and redstone power toggle scenarios. Standard lamp illuminates when powered; inverted lamp illuminates by default and turns off when powered. Done: Level 1 placement/hitbox and Level 4 redstone toggle scenarios pass for both standard and inverted lamps.
